Appendix A

Jubilee, Lehi Departure, Reign of Kings, Reign of

Judges, and Coming of Christ Calendars

Table Legend:

LD: Lehi Departure Calendar

Dates for the Reign of the King, Reign of the Judges and the Lehi Departure are identified as the New Year’s Day of the lunar year, and are a scientific New Moon date.

In the Jubilee Calendar BOLD = a Jubilee Year
